requirements: Protocol: each probe starts a fresh process; state persists only between its input lines. Read one JSON object per line and emit exactly one JSON object per line, with no other stdout. Object key order is immaterial; arrays are ordered. Inputs use exactly the documented keys; missing/extra keys, unknown operations, wrong types, null, booleans in integer positions and out-of-range values return {"error":"invalid_input"} without mutation, before any state-dependent checks. All quantities and logical times are integers; no wall clock, randomness, network or floating point is involved. Each followup applies independently to the base, never cumulatively. Followup rules override only the explicitly named base behavior.
Start with account amber=100 and account birch=40. balances takes only op and returns exactly {amber,birch}.

transfer takes exactly op, from, to and amount. from and to are distinct members of {amber,birch}; amount is an integer in 1..1000. After complete input validation, reject amount>source balance with insufficient_funds. Otherwise atomically subtract amount from source and add amount to destination, returning both balances. No fees exist. All errors leave both balances unchanged.

purchase is a second payment entrypath taking exactly op and amount (integer 1..1000). It applies the same atomic transfer policy from amber to birch, returning balances on success or insufficient_funds unchanged. It accepts no from/to keys.

vocabulary.atomic: A rejected transfer changes neither account.

protocol: Read one JSON object per stdin line until EOF; emit exactly one JSON object per input line, in order, with no other stdout. JSON object key order and equivalent number representations do not matter; arrays remain ordered. Exit zero. Each probe starts a fresh process in the same copied candidate tree. Gates and probes must not modify that tree. Followup verification also reruns all base probes.
safety: Not a hostile-code sandbox: candidate processes have same-user access. Run only on disposable cloud machines without secrets. Keep the scenario oracle outside the candidate tree.
